tonic.description: Restores some of an ally's HP.
tonic.flavor: A mouthful, then someone checks the wrist again.

mid_tonic.description: Restores more of an ally's HP than a Tonic.
mid_tonic.flavor: Enough to stand; not an excuse to keep standing.

ether.flavor: For the kind of tired a bottle can reach.

revive.description: Revives a fallen ally with part of their HP restored.
revive.flavor: Save the lecture until they're sitting up.

cobalt_wash.description: Clears Ink Blot, reveals hidden washi paths and paints untouchable paper foes.
cobalt_wash.flavor: Blue admits what white paint keeps denying.

time_atom.description: Repairs a small amount of Crono's porcelain integrity.
time_atom.flavor: A speck of time that can still be given back.

tungsten_scrap.description: Provides tungsten bracer material for crafting.
tungsten_scrap.flavor: Lucca kept jars for this sort of almost-nothing.

thoracic_ring_part.description: Provides a salvaged component for a later arm cannon.
thoracic_ring_part.flavor: The masks still count it as theirs.

bekkler_doll_small.description: Unlocks the training doll's Amber Rift and the choice to keep a vial when sealing Krona's vein.
bekkler_doll_small.flavor: At six, she picked the prize with Papa's hair.

gold_leaf_memory_flake.description: Combines with Cobalt Nodachi pigment for Crono's Gold Leaf repair in the Bone-Tree.
gold_leaf_memory_flake.flavor: The hearth went cold; the shape of home didn't.

vaelos_tooth.flavor: A clean young voice from a mouth that isn't there.

lavos_fibre_wrap.description: Strengthens Krona's Defiled Masamune with fibre torn from the Daimyo.
lavos_fibre_wrap.flavor: Strong binding. Keep eyes on blade.

cobalt_nodachi.description: Unlocks Krona's cobalt strike, reveals hidden Chronoslips and opens a portal back to U1.
cobalt_nodachi.flavor: One sunrise sharpened into something she can carry.

tungsten_wire_loom_bracer.description: Increases damage dealt just after an enemy is Broken.
tungsten_wire_loom_bracer.flavor: It came loose when the house finally unclenched.

epoch_gauntlet.description: Can be overcharged to unleash an Astral burst.
epoch_gauntlet.flavor: The wing-core flies no farther than his wrist now.
